create_Sam_model: create a Sam model instance with image encoder, prompt encoder, and mask decoder components
run_Sam_forward: run the Sam forward method to predict object masks from batched images and input prompts
preprocess_Sam_image: preprocess an input image tensor by normalizing pixel values and padding to square input
postprocess_Sam_masks: postprocess predicted masks by removing padding and upscaling to the original image size
build_Sam_predictor: build a Sam model with pixel mean and std for normalizing input images during mask prediction
